user.title: KakaoTalk Notifier
user.description: Enter the settings of your Kakao app. After saving, run the **kakao_talk.login** action (Developer tools > Actions) to log in to Kakao.

data_description.api_key: The REST API key of your Kakao app.
data_description.client_secret: Needed when the Client secret is enabled in the Kakao console (the default).
data_description.redirect_uri: Local address of Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.1.10:8123, without a path. Register it plus /api/kakao_talk as the Redirect URI at Kakao.
data_description.link_url: Address a tapped message (and its button) opens. Defaults to the Home Assistant address. Its domain must be registered at Kakao. To stop taps opening Home Assistant, use a harmless page on a registered domain, for example https://developers.kakao.com.
data_description.button_title: Label of the button in a message.
data_description.send_to_friends: Also send messages to Kakao Talk friends. Log in again after turning this on.
data_description.friends: Nicknames or uuids. Leave empty to send to every friend Kakao returns. Can be overridden per message.
data_description.link_to_image: Tapping an image message opens the image instead of Home Assistant. The image's domain must be registered at Kakao (App > Product Link > Web domain); if Kakao refuses the message, it is sent again with the normal link. Can be overridden per message.
data_description.invite_redirect_uri: Optional. A public address of Home Assistant (for example your Nabu Casa or own domain address, without a path) that friends are sent back to after they agree, so it works away from home. Register it plus /api/kakao_talk as a Redirect URI at Kakao. From the internet only the friend invite thank-you page is reachable.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.

abort.single_instance_allowed: KakaoTalk Notifier is already set up.
abort.already_configured: KakaoTalk Notifier is already set up in the UI. The configuration.yaml settings were ignored.
abort.invalid_import: The kakao_talk settings in configuration.yaml are invalid, so they were not imported. Set it up from the UI instead.

yaml_deprecated.title: KakaoTalk configuration.yaml settings are deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description: Your KakaoTalk Notifier settings were imported into **Settings > Devices & services**, which is now the only place they are used. Please remove the `kakao_talk:` block, and the `- platform: kakao_talk` entry under `notify:`, from `configuration.yaml`, then restart. Manual YAML configuration is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. The `notify.kakao_talk` action keeps working without it.
